insertions.exact_text: /// 模板包校验、清单改写或渲染阶段产生的结构化失败。
/// 新项目名称未通过共享的项目名称校验。
/// 嵌入条目路径不符合 `RelPath` 的词法相对路径约束。
/// 多个嵌入条目规范化后占用了相同的项目相对路径。
/// 一项的文件路径同时是另一项的目录祖先，导致条目布局无法逐项落盘。
/// 嵌入模板条目中没有必需的 `zircon-project.toml`。
/// 处理模板清单字节时，输入不能解码为 UTF-8。
/// 模板清单不能解析为 TOML 值。
/// 身份字段改写后的 TOML 清单无法重新编码。
/// 清单的 provider 选择缺失、重复，或不满足目标要求。
/// 改写后的清单未通过共享的项目摘要解析。

test_contracts.name: digest_is_independent_of_embedded_declaration_order
test_contracts.checks: same entry paths and bytes in a different iteration order produce equal digest.
test_contracts.limits: Does not prove collision resistance or every possible permutation.

test_contracts.name: digest_changes_when_a_path_or_payload_changes
test_contracts.checks: changing path or payload changes digest.
test_contracts.limits: Only those input differences are exercised.

test_contracts.name: digest_serializes_as_lowercase_hex_and_round_trips
test_contracts.checks: serde representation is lowercase hex and decoding returns equal digest.
test_contracts.limits: One wire representation/backend path; no exhaustive malformed-text corpus.

test_contracts.name: parse_accepts_only_the_canonical_template_id
test_contracts.checks: canonical string parses to RenderableEmpty; noncanonical input is rejected.
test_contracts.limits: One currently registered ID and chosen malformed input only.

test_contracts.name: creation_provenance_issues_the_exact_authenticated_identity
test_contracts.checks: issued receipt preserves the supplied operation, creator version, BuildSet, project GUID and descriptor identity.
test_contracts.limits: Does not establish the provenance inputs were actually admitted by startup policy.

test_contracts.name: receipt_round_trips_with_all_provenance_identity
test_contracts.checks: serialization/deserialization preserves fixture receipt fields.
test_contracts.limits: Fixture roundtrip only; no project creation or activation is run.

test_contracts.name: receipt_rejects_unknown_schema_and_fields
test_contracts.checks: unsupported schema version and unknown wire field are rejected.
test_contracts.limits: Only explicit fixture cases and serde path.

test_contracts.name: receipt_rejects_an_incompatible_creator_engine
test_contracts.checks: incompatible engine version fails receipt validation.
test_contracts.limits: One incompatible semver example only.

test_contracts.name: entry_render_rejects_duplicate_canonical_paths
test_contracts.checks: duplicate canonical relative path returns DuplicateEntryPath.
test_contracts.limits: Does not enumerate every path normalization collision.

test_contracts.name: entry_render_rejects_a_file_used_as_a_directory
test_contracts.checks: file ancestor/descendant conflict returns EntryPathConflictsWithFile.
test_contracts.limits: One conflict ordering and fixture.

test_contracts.name: render_rejects_a_manifest_that_weakens_a_required_provider
test_contracts.checks: provider selection weaker than descriptor requirement returns ManifestRequirements.
test_contracts.limits: No provider is loaded and no other target matrix is exercised.

test_contracts.name: render_accepts_provider_selection_without_target_modes
test_contracts.checks: valid selection is accepted when target_modes is omitted.
test_contracts.limits: Does not define defaults for unrelated manifest fields.

test_contracts.name: render_exposes_a_stable_qualified_template_descriptor
test_contracts.checks: render result exposes expected qualified ID/version and static descriptor identity.
test_contracts.limits: Single built-in descriptor fixture only.

test_contracts.name: template_descriptor_is_a_payload_free_registry_handle
test_contracts.checks: asserts descriptor handle contains registry identity without copied payload bytes.
test_contracts.limits: Size/layout assertion is local to this Rust type and target profile.

test_contracts.name: template_descriptor_round_trips_as_a_persistable_receipt_identity
test_contracts.checks: descriptor serde roundtrip returns same canonical descriptor.
test_contracts.limits: No external persistence service is exercised.

test_contracts.name: template_descriptor_rejects_forged_version_digest_and_capabilities
test_contracts.checks: tampered version/digest/capability wire values fail canonical descriptor deserialization.
test_contracts.limits: Only specified forged fields; not every wire mutation.

test_contracts.name: template_descriptor_rejects_unknown_entry_fields
test_contracts.checks: unknown entry wire field is rejected.
test_contracts.limits: One unknown-field case.

test_contracts.name: embedded_pack_matches_every_versioned_template_file
test_contracts.checks: embedded entry path set equals the versioned template source tree path set.
test_contracts.limits: Checks the static fixture inventory; not runtime loading or destination filesystem.

test_contracts.name: render_rewrites_only_manifest_identity_and_preserves_current_schema
test_contracts.checks: checks rendered manifest identity and current schema while asserting fixture-specific retained fields.
test_contracts.limits: One built-in template fixture; does not prove arbitrary manifests preserve all fields.

test_contracts.name: render_reuses_portable_project_name_admission_without_trimming
test_contracts.checks: rejects chosen nonportable names and confirms no implicit trim before shared validator.
test_contracts.limits: Examples do not prove compatibility with every filesystem.

test_contracts.name: renderable_empty_scene_declares_a_static_cube_with_persisted_project_references
test_contracts.checks: TOML assertions inspect fixture static scene/entity and persisted project references.
test_contracts.limits: No Runtime scene deserialization or rendering occurs.

test_contracts.name: renderable_empty_asset_metadata_matches_its_persisted_references
test_contracts.checks: fixture asset metadata references agree with stored GUID/path hints.
test_contracts.limits: Metadata contract assertions only, not actual asset resolution.

test_contracts.name: template_source_tree_contains_no_links_or_reparse_points
test_contracts.checks: walk rejects symlinks/reparse points in source template fixture.
test_contracts.limits: Host filesystem fixture check; no output tree is materialized.
